En svensk förf. Fredrik Lindholm, har någon gång år 1909 "gjort" en skrift om anarkismen, vari han åtagit sig att framställa anarkismens uppgifter. Skriftens huvudsakliga innehåll har blivit ett upprepande av de kungamord och tsarmord, som anarkisterna anklagats för, och i vissa fall väl även utfört.

Den omfattar en period då despotismen, liksom nu i många länder, intog högsätet, då folket var helt rättslöst, då anarkisterna och andra motståndare till stats- och utsugningsmonopolen, behandlades som förbrytare och fördrevs ur landet. Ofta fanns det blott en utväg att väcka uppmärksamhet för dessa ohyggliga förhållanden: Bombens detonation.

Bomben var avsedd eller träffade en herre som i sitt dagliga liv, kanske tanklöst, undertecknat hundratals dödsdomar och förvisningar, som framställde sig vara i kompani med gud, innehade kontroll över alla kanaler till det existerande rättsväsendet, befallde över polis och militär, följaktligen utövade ensam härskarmakt eller representerande sådan makt.

Jag anser mig inte i detta sammanhang ha någon befogenhet att diskutera huruvida det var rätt eller inte. Det skulle bli en alltför vidlyftig avhandling, att framställa vad man talar för och emot i ett sammanhang som detta. Våldet har alltid karaktäriserats som ultima ratio, en sista utväg.

I anarkismens politiska och sociala tankevärld har våldet ingen plats. Såväl de politiska som sociala uttrycksformerna skapar en miljö och atmosfär, som avlägsnar ifrån våldet och främjar inbördes hjälp. Dessa förändringar bygger anarkisterna inte på en sinnets förändring som grundlag, men på fakta som att möjligheterna för det sociala välståndets fördelning uppnåtts och herraväldets och förtryckets förverkligande avlägsnats.

Den fulländning som anarkismens samhällsideal företräder bygger på orsakernas upphävande, orsakerna till våldsmentaliteten.

De invändningar som göras, bygga på helt andra förutsättningar. Den ägande som fruktar för att tjuvar och rånare skola tillägna sig hans egendom, vinkar indignerat bort pratet om att våldet skulle bli överflödigt, noggrant förbiseende att människorna under kommunistiskt-anarkistiska samhällsformer inte ha någon anledning att stjäla eller med våld försvara sig mot stöld.

Militären, som tränat in sin yrkesmentalitet och den fanatiske chauvinisten komma med sina argument! Skola vi inte försvara oss mot utländska fiender?

Här är en fråga som redan nuet borde taga klar ställning till. Finns det någon mening i att försvara sig mot utländska fiender? Vad är det man kan och vill försvara? Marken, naturen, sjöarna, kan inte försvaras, kan inte erövras. Under ett krig kan man däremot förstöra dem. Ja, måste förstöra. Fransmän och belgare förstörde stora delar av sina egna områden, direkt, när tyskarna trängde fram under världskriget, förstörde för att inte tyskarna skulle få nytta av det. Franska och belgiska sprängämnen och volymkulor träffade fransk och belgisk natur - och förstörde kanske lika mycket som "fienden", tyskarna, förstörde.

Krigets mekanisering är ett kapitel som vilar tungt på vågen när det gäller att mäta våldets uppgift i nuet. Förr, när en hord människor dreva mot varandra med pikar och muskedunder, var det hela ett farligt äventyr, som begränsades av vapnens räckvidd. Nu finnes det inte längre någon sådan begränsning. Brand-, gift- och spränggaser ha förverkat varje tanke på "försvar" och mobiliserat angreppstanken som enda möjlighet i en våldskonflikt mellan staterna. De långskjutande kanonerna understryka denna utveckling. Ett krig blir blott ett fruktansvärt förgörande av allt levande.

Enda synpunkten som talar för att med krigets våld lösa de mellanfolkliga konflikterna, är den, att vapenfabrikerna och sprängämnestillverkarna behöva experimentera och måste ha stora dividender.

¿QUÉ es el patriotismo? ¿Es el amor por el lugar donde uno nació, el lugar de los recuerdos y las esperanzas de la infancia, de los sueños y las aspiraciones? ¿Es el lugar donde, con ingenuidad infantil, contemplábamos las nubes fugaces y nos preguntábamos por qué nosotros tampoco podíamos correr tan rápido? ¿El lugar donde contábamos los miles de millones de estrellas centelleantes, aterrorizados ante la idea de que cada una de ellas fuera «un ojo» que traspasara lo más profundo de nuestras pequeñas almas? ¿Es el lugar donde escuchábamos el canto de los pájaros y anhelábamos tener alas para volar, como ellos, hacia tierras lejanas? ¿O el lugar donde nos sentábamos a los pies de nuestra madre, embelesados por maravillosos relatos de grandes hazañas y conquistas? En resumen, ¿es el amor por ese lugar, donde cada pulgada representa recuerdos queridos y preciosos de una infancia feliz, alegre y juguetona?

Si eso fuera patriotismo, pocos hombres estadounidenses de hoy en día podrían considerarse patriotas, ya que el lugar de juego se ha convertido en fábrica, molino y mina, mientras que los sonidos ensordecedores de la maquinaria han sustituido a la música de los pájaros. Tampoco podemos ya escuchar las historias de grandes hazañas, pues las que cuentan hoy nuestras madres no son más que historias de dolor, lágrimas y aflicción.

¿Qué es, entonces, el patriotismo? «El patriotismo, señor, es el último recurso de los sinvergüenzas», dijo el Dr. Johnson. León Tolstói, el mayor antipatriota de nuestro tiempo, define el patriotismo como el principio que justifica la formación de asesinos en masa; un oficio que requiere mejor equipamiento para el ejercicio del asesinato que para la fabricación de artículos de primera necesidad como zapatos, ropa y viviendas; un oficio que garantiza mejores beneficios y mayor gloria que el del trabajador medio.

Gustave Hervé [1], otro gran antipatriota, califica acertadamente el patriotismo de superstición —una mucho más perjudicial, brutal e inhumana que la religión—. La superstición de la religión tuvo su origen en la incapacidad del hombre para explicar los fenómenos naturales. Es decir, cuando el hombre primitivo oía un trueno o veía un relámpago, no podía dar una explicación a ninguno de ellos y, por lo tanto, concluía que detrás de ellos debía de haber una fuerza mayor que él mismo. Del mismo modo, veía una fuerza sobrenatural en la lluvia y en los diversos cambios que se producen en la naturaleza. El patriotismo, por el contrario, es una superstición creada artificialmente y mantenida a través de una red de mentiras y falsedades; una superstición que despoja al hombre de su autoestima y dignidad, y aumenta su arrogancia y vanidad.

De hecho, la vanidad, la arrogancia y el egoísmo son los elementos esenciales del patriotismo. Permítanme ilustrarlo. El patriotismo parte de la base de que nuestro planeta está dividido en pequeños rincones, cada uno rodeado por una verja de hierro. Quienes han tenido la suerte de nacer en un rincón concreto se consideran mejores, más nobles, más grandiosos y más inteligentes que los seres vivos que habitan en cualquier otro rincón. Por lo tanto, es deber de todo aquel que vive en ese rincón elegido luchar, matar y morir en el intento de imponer su superioridad sobre todos los demás.

title: Killing King Abacus - Notizen zu einer neuen Analyse der Institutionen der Herrschaft
content:

Es ist kaum 65 Jahre her, da war es absolut üblich, in der anarchistischen Literatur Analysen der Institutionen zu lesen, in denen sich die verschiedenen Formen der Herrschaft manifestierten. Wenn man beispielsweise über die Unterdrückung der Frauen schrieb, dann wurden die Familie und die Ehe untersucht und bloßgestellt. Wenn die Unterdrückung von Vergnügen und der Freude des Lebens zur Diskussion stand, dann wurden Religion und Gesetz ins Visier genommen. Der institutionelle Rahmen, in dem sich diese Gesellschaft abspielt wurde als Quelle der Ausbeutung, Herrschaft und Entfremdung wahrgenommen.

Es scheint so, als wäre dieser institutionelle Rahmen in jüngerer Zeit größtenteils vergessen worden zu sein. Von den verschiedenen Institutionen, in die unser entfremdetes kreatives Potenzial zu unserem Nachteil akkumuliert wurde, scheinen nur noch der Staat und das Kapital (und gelegentlich die Technologie) in einem bedeutenden Ausmaß Erwähnung zu finden und selbst diese werden häufig mehr als Geisteszustände, denn als konkrete soziale Institutionen behandelt. So entdecken wir beispielsweise, dass Anarchist*innen gegen Staatlichkeit (was auch immer das sein soll) sind, anstatt gegen den Staat. Auf diese Weise kann etwa ein Bookchin behaupten, gegen Staatlichkeit zu sein, während er den altertümlichen griechischen Stadt-Staat als Modell für seine demokratisierte Version der „Anarchie“ bewirbt.

Jede andere Form der Unterdrückung wird ebenfalls zu einem „-ismus“ (Rassismus, Sexismus, usw.) oder schlimmerem (Homophobie impliziert beispielsweise eine psychologische Störung, die einer Behandlung bedarf, anstatt einer sozialen Repression, die nach Revolte verlangt). Natürlich verleugnen wir nicht die Realitäten der Ideologien der Bigotterie und ihrer Durchdringung der Gedanken und Gefühle der Ausgebeuteten und Unterdrückten. Aber ohne ein Verständnis des institutionellen Rahmens der Unterdrückung und Herrschaft ist es nicht möglich zu verstehen, wie die herrschende Klasse diese Ideologien dazu nutzt, diejenigen zu spalten, die sie ausbeutet.

Selbst die anscheinend Radikalsten (weil ihre Rhetorik am extremsten ist) innerhalb des anarchistischen Millieus entgehen dem nicht. Die von primitivistischen und antizivilisatorischen Kreisen kommende Kritik richtet ihre verbalen Angriffe allzu häufig gegen eine nebulöse, schlecht definierte Zivilisation. Gewiss klingt „Für die Zerstörung der Zivilisation“ radikal. Meiner eigenen Definition gemäß stimme ich damit sogar überein. Aber meiner Definition nach ist Zivilisation nicht irgendeine nebulöse, weitestgehend mentale Kategorie, die dem Rationalismus oder dem westlichen Denken oder welcher unerwünschten Denkweise auch immer entspringt; sie ist ein Netzwerk konkreter sozialer Institutionen, die ich in meinem Alltag konfrontiere: Staat, Wirtschaft, Religion, die Familie, technologische Systeme, und so weiter, allesamt sehr reale Entitäten, die nicht von Gedankenspielen beseitigt werden werden.

Und genau hier tappt die derzeitige Tendenz in eine Falle. Wenn eine Analyse des institutionellen Rahmens der Unterdrückung, Ausbeutung, Herrschaft und Entfremdung vergessen wird, dann tritt Therapie an die Stelle von Revolution. Wir sind dann gezwungen, uns mit den pathetischen, weinerlichen Geständnissen eines Chris Crass zu beschäftigen oder auch der schlechten Popkultur-Psychologie der Autor*innen des Textes „Stick it to the Manarchy“ (wobei schon der Gebrauch eines Begriffs wie „manarchy“ ein sicheres Zeichen dafür ist, dass jemand nichts hörenswertes zu sagen hat), die versuchen ihren „Sexismus“, „Rassismus“, „Homophobie“ und „Klassismus“ abzulegen, die nicht länger irgendwelche Ideologien der Bigotterie sind, sondern niedere mentale Krankheiten, unter denen die selbsternannten „Privilegierten“ aller Klassen leiden.

Jede*r ernsthafte revolutionäre Anarchist*in muss sehen, dass das nur eine weitere List der Feiglinge und jener ist, die ein Interesse an der Aufrechterhaltung der herrschenden Ordnung haben, die eigentliche Entscheidung darüber, auf wessen Seite sie im Kampf gegen diese Gesellschaft stehen, aufzuschieben. Diejenigen von uns, die es mit der Zerstörung der gegenwärtigen Welt ernst meinen, um unsere Leben selbst zu gestalten, haben keine Zeit für diese selbstgerechten Gedankenspielereien, die so sehr an Selbsthilfegruppen erinnern („Mein Name ist … …

author: rezgar2
title: نحو أممية يسارية رقمية في مواجهة الرأسمالية الرقمية، اليسار الرقمي في زمن الخوارزميات
content:
إن المعركة حول التكنولوجيا هي أيضاً معركة حول الملكية والسلطة والوعي ومستقبل البشرية. ومع اتساع دور الفضاء الرقمي بوصفه إحدى الساحات الرئيسية للصراع الطبقي، يمكن للأممية اليسارية الرقمية أن تصبح نقطة انطلاق لتجديد العمل الأممي عموماً. ويتمثل التحدي اليوم في البناء على التشخيص بأدوات جماعية للمواجهة، وفي تطوير التعاون العملي القائم بين قوى اليسار وتوسيعه، ليكمل المواقف والبيانات التضامنية بعمل مشترك أكثر تنظيماً واستمرارية، وفي التوجه التدريجي من منصات الاحتكارات إلى بدائل مستقلة وديمقراطية. وبذلك يمكن أن تتحول إمكانات الثورة الرقمية من امتياز تستأثر به حفنة من الشركات والدول الكبرى إلى مكسب عام يخدم الإنسان وتحرره.

صدر حديثاً كتاب «نحو أممية يسارية رقمية في مواجهة الرأسمالية الرقمية، اليسار الرقمي في زمن الخوارزميات» نصوص ودراسات وبرنامج عمل حول اليسار الرقمي والأممية اليسارية الرقمية، من إعدادي وتأليفي، وهو متاح إلكترونياً ومجاناً.

يشهد العالم ثورة رقمية متسارعة تعيد تشكيل الاقتصاد والعمل والسياسة والوعي الإنساني. وفي الوقت الذي تفتح فيه هذه الثورة إمكانات هائلة للتقدم والتحرر البشري وتجاوز الفقر والأمراض، تتركز ملكية أدواتها ومواردها الأساسية في أيدي حفنة من الاحتكارات الرأسمالية المدعومة من الدول الكبرى. وفي المقابل، تتسع الاحتجاجات الجماهيرية والشبابية في كثير من بلدان العالم، مستفيدة من الأدوات الرقمية في التنظيم والتعبئة، ومؤكدة أن الظروف الموضوعية لتجاوز الرأسمالية قائمة.

ومن هذا التناقض تنبع الحاجة إلى مسار متكامل يبدأ بفهم الرأسمالية الرقمية، ويمر بإغناء تجربة اليسار فكرياً وتنظيمياً بما يواكب التطورات الراهنة، وصولاً إلى بناء أممية يسارية رقمية قادرة على التأثير.

تتيح الثورة الرقمية تقليص ساعات العمل، وتطوير الخدمات الصحية والتعليمية، وتحرير الإنسان من الأعمال المرهقة والمتكررة. غير أن هذه الإمكانات تتطور في إطار علاقات إنتاج رأسمالية، تستحوذ فيها الاحتكارات على القسم الأكبر من مكاسب التقدم التكنولوجي.

فالخوارزميات والمنصات الرقمية ليست محايدة اجتماعياً أو طبقياً، إذ تتأثر بعلاقات الملكية والتمويل والإدارة. وتتجاوز هذه الهيمنة حدود الاقتصاد إلى تشكيل الوعي وتوسيع المراقبة وتوظيف التكنولوجيا في القتل والحروب، ويزيد تقارب بعض قوى اليمين المتطرف مع الاحتكارات التكنولوجية من مخاطر الفاشية الرقمية.

وأمام هذا الواقع، يبرز السؤال الجوهري: كيف يقاوم اليسار الرأسمالية في طورها الرقمي المتقدم، ويفتح الطريق نحو بديل اشتراكي إنساني أكثر عدلاً، محلياً وعالمياً؟ وكيف يجدد نفسه ويطورها ليكون قادراً على ذلك؟

فقد أصبحت الرأسمالية الرقمية قوة عابرة للحدود، بينما يبقى جزء كبير من العمل اليساري الرقمي محصوراً داخل الأطر الوطنية، ويعاني ضعف التنسيق الرقمي الأممي. وتكشف التجارب الحديثة حجم الخطر الذي يواجهه اليسار في هذا الميدان.

ففي البرازيل، وخلال سباق رئاسي بالغ التقارب عام 2026 بين لولا دا سيلفا ومرشح اليمين المتطرف فلافيو بولسونارو، اتهم لولا وحزبه شركة ميتا بتقليص انتشار منشوراته لمصلحة خصمه. وتدخلت المحكمة الانتخابية العليا وألزمت الشركة بتقديم توضيحات، ونشرت صحيفة «فولها دي ساو باولو» مراسلات داخلية يقر فيها موظفون في الشركة بأن قيود المنصة أضرت بحسابات لولا، فيما تحدثت ميتا عن «أعطال تقنية». ورغم ذلك، حسمت التعبئة الجماهيرية جولة الإعادة لصالح لولا.

وفي ألمانيا، وظّف إيلون ماسك منصته «إكس» لدعم حزب «البديل من أجل ألمانيا» اليميني المتطرف قبيل انتخابات فبراير 2025، عبر مقالات التأييد وبثّ حوار مباشر مع زعيمته أليس فايدل، فيما رصدت دراسات انحياز خوارزميات المنصة لصالح محتوى الحزب. وفي كولومبيا، وبعد جولة إعادة حسمت لمرشح اليمين المتطرف بفارق نحو نقطة مئوية واحدة، اتهم الرئيس غوستافو بيترو شركة سايبر إسرائيلية بنشر نصف مليون حساب آلي زائف للتلاعب بالناخبين، وطعن في سلامة برمجيات الفرز وانحياز المنصات الرقمية لليمين المتطرف. ومهما انتهى إليه التحقيق، فإن انتقال الطعن في انتخابات بلد بأكمله إلى ميدان الخوارزميات والحسابات الآلية يكشف طبيعة المرحلة التي نعيشها.

أما المثال الأوضح فجاء من المحكمة الجنائية الدولية. فبعد أن أصدر قضاتها مذكرات توقيف بحق مسؤولين إسرائيليين بتهم ارتكاب جرائم حرب في غزة، فرضت الإدارة الأمريكية عقوبات على عدد من قضاتها ومسؤوليها، فأغلقت شركات أمريكية حساباتهم المصرفية والرقمية. وإذا كانت الرأسمالية مستعدة لفعل ذلك بمحكمة دولية تضم أكثر من مئة وعشرين دولة عضواً، فماذا ستفعل بمشروع يساري يصبح مؤثراً ويسعى إلى كسر هيمنتها، ويتجاوز الخطوط الحمراء التي رسمتها؟

وتمتد هذه الهيمنة إلى الحياة اليومية للناشطات والناشطين، عبر عقوبات رقمية تفرضها المنصات على من يفضح جرائم الحرب الإسرائيلية وانتهاكات دول أخرى، أو يطرح خطاباً يسارياً جذرياً. وتبدأ هذه العقوبات بالتضييق وتقليص الانتشار والتهميش، وتصل إلى حذف المحتوى وإغلاق الحسابات. وقد وثقت منظمات حقوق الإنسان الدولية هذه الممارسات وأدانتها، ومنها تقرير «هيومن رايتس ووتش» عن الرقابة الممنهجة على المحتوى الفلسطيني في منصات ميتا. ويدفع هذا القمع الرقمي كثيراً من الناشطات والناشطين إلى رقابة ذاتية طوعية، فيعدلون خطابهم ويتجنبون قضايا بعينها خوفاً من الحظر …

author: Unknown
title: We Have Fed You All for a Thousand Years
content:
Title

: We Have Fed You All for a Thousand Years

Subtitle

: Travels of a Protest Poem

Source

: KSL: Bulletin of the Kate Sharpley Library No. 122, October 2026


A Humble Reminder : To the Propertied Classes


 (Slightly altered from Rudyard Kipling’s Ode in praise of English Enterprise.)


 We have fed you all for a thousand years,

 And you hail us still unfed,

 Though there’s never a pound of all your pounds

 But marks the workers’ dead;

 We have yielded our best to give you rest,

 And you lie on a crimson wool,

 For if blood be the price of England’s wealth,

 Good God, we ha’ paid in full.


 There’s never a mine blown skyward now

 But we’re buried alive for you;

 There’s never a wreck drifts shoreward now

 But it’s we are the ghastly crew;

 Go, reckon our dead by the forges red,

 And the factories where we spin;

 If blood be the price of England’s wealth,

 Good God, we ha’ paid it in.


 We have fed you all for a thousand years,

 For that was our doom, you know,

 From the days when you chained us in your fields

 To the strike of a week ago;

 You have eaten our lives and our babes and wives,

 And we’re told it’s your legal share;

 But if blood be the price of England’s wealth,

 Good God, we ha’ bought it fair.


 N.


 


 In September 1893 the London anarchist newspaper

Freedom : A Journal of Anarchist Communism

 published a poem called ‘A Humble Reminder : To the Propertied Classes’, credited to ‘N.’

[1]

 It’s an anti-capitalist protest, lamenting the ‘workers’ dead’ whose deaths enriched those ‘propertied classes’. It rails at the rich ‘We have fed you all for a thousand years, / And you hail us still unfed’. I do not know who ‘N.’ was, though they seem to be connected to the

Freedom

 milieu.

Freedom

 had published another poem by them, ‘The Pet Voter’, in August 1892.

[2]

 Max Nettlau used the same initial when writing in

Freedom

 in June 1891; the Fabian socialist Edith Nesbit had a poem ‘A Word For The Children’ in

Freedom

 in February 1891 (‘The right to give help is your own, / The right to claim it theirs.’) Neither seems a convincing candidate for the authorship of this poem.


The Kipling connection


 ‘N.’ introduced their poem by saying it was ‘slightly altered from Rudyard Kipling’s Ode in praise of English Enterprise.’ That’s a reference to Kipling’s ‘Song of the Dead’ published four months earlier in

The English Illustrated Magazine

 (May 1893). ‘N.’s address to the propertied classes ‘For if blood be the price of England’s wealth, / Good God, we ha’ paid in full’ rewrites Kipling’s address to the sea ‘If blood be the price of admiralty, / Lord God, we ha’ paid in full!’.

[3]

 The ‘Humble Reminder’ changes Kipling’s poem – but leans heavily upon it. Mark Leier said ‘strictly speaking the poem is not a parody of Kipling’s poem but a re-working of the words based on the original verse and meter.’

[4]

 It reminds me of Utah Philips’ comment on IWW songmaking: ‘The Wobblies liked to steal the hymn tunes ‘cos they were pretty and change the words so they made more sense.’

[5]


 The connection to Kipling persisted. He was credited in many of the reprints (inevitable, perhaps, given that the author remained unknown and their debt to Kipling was clear). There were even articles discussing what it would mean if the poem were by Kipling.

[6]


Reprinted and recited


 Once printed, it was always possible for the poem to reappear, and this one spread beyond the anarchist press, becoming a standard of labour movement papers. The title often changed, varying from ‘The Cry of Toil’ to ‘The Capitalist’. Just as the connection to Kipling is sometimes there and sometimes not, the text varies between the poetic ‘ha’’ to the everyday ‘have’.


 Apparently a version was published in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania in 1895.

[7]

 The Portland anarchist newspaper

The Firebrand

 reprinted the poem (anonymously) as ‘The Workers Outcry’ in 1897.

[8]

 Changes had been made to Americanise the text: instead of pounds the third line talks of ‘there’s never a dollar of all your wealth’.


 Sometimes you can read about the poem’s life off the printed page. In May 1897 Miss Olive Keep recited ‘We have fed you all for a thousand years’ at a gathering of the Socialist Labor Party.

[9]

. In August 1899,

The Carpenter

, a union journal for ‘Carpenters, Stair Builders, Machine Wood Workers, Planing Mill Men, and Kindred Interests’ reprinted the ‘Firebrand version’ (with credit) …

author: Unknown
title: Anonym - Die Systeme der Organisation
content:
Katalog Liste aller Texte AutorInnen Themen Letzte Einträge Zur Bibliothek hinzufügen

Mehr Kontakt Material Sticker, Plakate, etc.

Es drängt uns, eine Frage von eminenter Wichtigkeit und folgenschwerer Bedeutung unter das Secirmesser der Kritik zu bringen, die Organisationsfrage nämlich. Es ist dieser Gegenstand von weit grösserer Wichtigkeit und Tragweite, als es bei einer flüchtigen Betrachtung den Schein haben mag: denn die Organisation ist das wichtigste Werkzeug des obschwebenden geistigen Riesenkampfes, und ist von grosser Wichtigkeit, ob eben dieses Instrument scharf und spitzig oder schartig und stumpf ist: die Organisation kann aber auch, wenn sie tauglich geformt wird, zur wirksamen Triebkraft, zum zweckdienlichen Sauerteige für die künftige Kulturform werden, sowie andererseits zum Geiste, der beschworen wurde und sich nicht zähmen lässt, wie der von Goethe’s Zauberlehrling.

Dem Wesen nach unterscheiden wir zwei Systeme der Organisation, und zwar den Centralismus und den Föderalismus. Beide sollen nun untersucht werden.

Was zunächst den Centralismus anbelangt, so ist derselbe nichts Anderes wie ein misslungener Abklatsch des despotischen oder absoluten Regierungssystems und zeigt uns, dass nicht allein der Affe, sondern auch der Mensch den Nachahmungstrieb besitzt.

Die Despotie zeigt uns den Centralismus in seiner vollendetsten und ausgebildetsten Form.

Caligula und Nero, Philipp der Zweite von Spanien und Richard III. von England, sowie Ludwig XI. von Frankreich: sie Alle waren Centralisten, die unser Augenmerk fesseln, denn sie waren gross, wenn auch als Tyrannen, wenn auch im Schlechten, sie ragen über die Mittelmässigkeit hoch empor: sie waren Verbrecher an der Menschenwürde, aber sie waren es voll Kraft und Mut, voll Kühnheit und Energie. Was sind aber die Tyrännchen, die sich die Arbeiter durch den Centralismus erzeugen, indem sie sich von Mauldreschern bethören lassen? Erbärmliche Jammergestalten im Vergleiche mit jenen Titanen, deren Andenken glühenden Hass in unserer Seele weckt? Sie sind armselige Zwerge, Liliputaner, und thun wohl daran, sich spreizen und viel und laut von der Redner-Tribüne herunter zu deklamiren und zu kreischen, denn sonst würde man sie gar nicht wahrnehmen. Sie zu verachten, wäre zu viel Ehre für sie, nein, ein mitleidiges Bedauern ist Alles, was ihnen zugewendet werden kann. Sie sind der Vergessenheit geweiht und haben dereinst zwecklos gelebt: das alleinige Ziel ihres Strebens ist das Wohlleben, und dafür treten sie das Heiligste, Erhabenste, die himmlische, ewige Idee in den Kot: sie unterscheiden sich in nichts von einem Mastschwein, das auf nichts denkt wie auf vielen und guten Mais und einen trefflichen Stall, nur erstreben sie beides in einer anderen Form. Ärmliche, kleinliche Menschlein! – Und sie wären vielleicht fähig, ihr ephemeres Sein an die ewige unvergängliche Kette von Ursachen und Wirkungen, Grund und Folge zu knüpfen und ewig zu sein im Erlösungswerk der Menschheit durch ihr fruchtbringendes Wirken, sie wären vielleicht befähigt zu schaffen, so dass sie darin das reinste Glück, ein Gefühl von Seligkeit empfänden im Glücke und Paradieses-Sein Aller, dass sie für künftige Generationen anzubahnen helfen würden.

Der Centralismus vernichtet die individuelle Selbstständigkeit und Freiheit vollständig, wie wir es im despotischen Staat antreffen. Hier ist der Wille des Autokraten Gesetz, dort der Wille des Parteigötzen, den man auf das Piedestal emporhob: der Druck ist ärger noch als im despotischen Staat, denn in einem solchen soll nur eine gesetzwidrige Handlung gerichtet werden; die Spitze der centralistischen Pyramide aber richtet nicht allein die Handlungen, sondern sogar die Meinungen, sie erforscht Herz und Nieren der Menschen wie Jehova, und es sollte auch der Wille solcher Parteigötzen unter Donner und Blitz zeitweilig verkündet werden, wenigstens hätte das Colophonium stärkeren Absatz und die Spängler fänden bei der Anfertigung von Donnerblechen vielleicht lohnende Arbeit.

Treffend bezeichnet ein Engländer den Centralismus, indem er sagt: “Stelle ein Schaf vor die andern und Du hast die Herde fertig.” Ja wohl, eine Herde ist es und weiter nichts, und diese Herde geht hin, wohin der Hammel sie führt, und wenn er in einen Sumpf hineinplumpst, so wandern Alle in den Morast, und thatsächlich stecken gegenwärtig die Bekenner der alleinseligmachenden Sozialdemokratie mit ihrer achtundvierziger Theorie im Schlamme der Reformpolitik und leiden an …

author: Thomas More
title: A Guide to the Study of Marx - Max Beer
content:
A short study-circle syllabus on Marx by the socialist historian Max Beer. It was published in 1924 by the Labour Research Department as part of its workers’ education series. It covers three areas: Marx’s general views (class society, the relativity of economic and ethical concepts, the Hegelian inheritance), historic materialism, and political economy, from surplus value to the falling rate of profit. It also includes a short biographical sketch of Marx and a suggested order for reading Capital. It ends with G. D. H. Cole’s practical hints for students and class leaders, and period adverts from the Plebs League and the Communist Bookshop. It is a good example of how Marxism was taught to British worker-students in the 1920s.

Labour Research Department, LRD

title: Why Alex Contompasis deserves Executive Clemency
content:
More than five years have passed since January 6, 2021, a date forever linked with one of the most divisive moments in modern American history.

by Don Ritter (The Saratogian)


While the nation’s attention focused on the attack on the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C., another violent confrontation unfolded hundreds of miles away outside the New York State Capitol in Albany during a “Stop the Steal” rally. It was there that Albany resident Alex Contompasis became involved in a violent altercation that ultimately resulted in his conviction and a lengthy prison sentence.


Today, a striking contradiction exists. Nearly all of the individuals convicted of federal crimes arising from the January 6 events at the U.S. Capitol have been released after President Donald Trump issued sweeping pardons and commutations in January 2025. Yet Alex Contompasis remains incarcerated in New York State. 


Whether one agrees with his politics is not the issue. The real question is whether justice has been served and whether executive clemency is appropriate. Supporters argue that Contompasis believed he was defending himself and others during a rapidly escalating confrontation involving members of the Proud Boys and counter-protesters. They contend that the circumstances were chaotic, emotions were high, and decisions had to be made in seconds rather than after hours of legal analysis. Advocates have continued to campaign for clemency, arguing that his sentence is disproportionate and that his case raises broader questions about New York’s self-defense laws.


The courts, however, viewed the evidence differently. An Albany County jury convicted Contompasis, and in 2025, the Appellate Division unanimously upheld his conviction, concluding that the evidence supported the verdict and rejecting his self-defense arguments. Still, executive clemency exists precisely because the legal system recognizes that mercy may sometimes be appropriate even after a lawful conviction.One of the strongest arguments for clemency is consistency. The federal government chose to extend extraordinary mercy to those convicted of offenses connected to the January 6 attack on the U.S. Capitol, including individuals convicted of assaulting police officers and other serious crimes. Whether one


supported or opposed those pardons, they fundamentally changed the landscape of January 6 justice. Against that backdrop, Contompasis’ continued imprisonment appears, to many observers, increasingly difficult to reconcile. Executive clemency is not a declaration that someone was legally innocent. It is an acknowledgment that mercy, fairness, rehabilitation, or broader public interests justify reducing or ending a sentence. Governors and presidents have exercised this authority throughout American history.

New York Governor Kathy Hochul has granted numerous pardons and commutations during her administration after reviewing evidence of rehabilitation and other equitable considerations. If executive clemency is intended to recognize cases deserving individualized consideration, then supporters argue that


Alex Contompasis deserves that consideration as well.Reasonable people can disagree about what happened outside the State Capitol that day. They can disagree about whether Contompasis acted reasonably, whether he overreacted, or whether the jury reached the correct verdict. Those debates will likely continue for years. But clemency is not about retrying a criminal


case. Instead, it asks whether continued imprisonment still serves the interests of justice.If New York believes in redemption, proportionality, and individualized review, then Contompasis’ petition deserves careful consideration. His supporters argue that enough time has passed, that he no longer presents a danger to society, and that continued incarceration accomplishes little beyond extending punishment.


Others will disagree and believe the seriousness of the assault warrants completion of the sentence.


Ultimately, clemency is an act of executive judgment, not judicial review. It allows elected leaders to balance justice with mercy when extraordinary circumstances warrant. Whether Governor Hochul ultimately agrees is her decision alone. Under New York law, she has constitutional authority to grant pardons and commutations after reviewing the facts of each individual case.As New York continues to reflect on the divisions exposed on January 6, it may also be time to ask whether mercy has been …

author: Kodao Productions
title: Sara’s clown show at the Senate
content:
The Nov. 9 and 10 impeachment trial sessions of Sara Zimmerman Duterte Carpio turned out to be poorly choreographed, with the defense witnesses apparently unprepared to handle questions from the prosecution, with two of them suffering from instant amnesia and can’t recall joining an all-expenses paid excursion to China the previous year. One, Davao City assessor Jaime Adalin, even tried to be funny by tagging a question “irrelevant,” and drew guffaws from the gallery.


However, he could determine a property of Sara’s husband, Manases Carpio, is listed in Sara’s SALNs even without seeing the coordinates, or the meters and bounds, of the asset. His testimony runs afoul of the testimony of two property registrars who said Carpio’s landholdings were not reflected in Duterte’s SALN. Davao City Register of Deeds IV Kathy Florence Baldonado testified that Carpio had acquired a 379-sq-m lot in Juna Subdivision, Matina Crossing, Talomo, Davao City, which was not declared in her SALN.


Samal Deputy Register of Deeds III Marco Pineda testified that Carpio bought a 751-sq-m lot in Matanos for P3,453,849 on March 15, 2018. Pineda said no entry in Duterte’s SALN matched the deed of absolute sale for that property. However, when shown images of a building from Google Maps with the sign “Prime Bistro,” Adalin admitted he wasn’t sure. He can’t remember the China journey and couldn’t be certain that it was the property which he said was included in Sara’s SALNs. On Nov. 10, the defense presented its second witness, Samal City Assessor Engr. John Kenneth Enumerables, who will testify on property records linked to Atty. Manases Carpio.


Presiding officer Sen. Chiz Escudero said senators might be confused with the location of the Carpio property in the deed of sale since it says the property is located in Barangay San Isidro but the TCT shows the lot is in Barangay Matanos. Enumerables says it is a small matter, a mere technical description. Sen. Panfilo Lacson said Matanos is actually located in Barangay Pangubatan, which Enumerables confirmed. Prosecutor Prosecutor Benjamon Tolosa Jr. noted that the deed of Absolute Sale for the property was executed on March 2018, while Duterte’s 2025 SALN showed the property was acquired in 2013. Enumerables acknowledged the discrepancy and said he is not certain if the property in the TCT is the same property in the SALN.


If Adalin performed badly for the defense, Davao City accountant Vingelin Bajan snatched the bragging rights for the day’s worst dodger. Bajan claimed she wasn’t friends with Sara Zimmerman Suterte Carpio when she was appointed city accountant in 2026. Apparently, prosecutor Mae Divinagracia argued, Sara trusted Bajan so much that she appointed her chairperson of the City Audit and Transition Teams for Barangays in 2018, and as member of the Investigating Committee of Davao City in 2020.


Divinagracia asked Bajan if the accounting firm she worked for was registered in 2023 with the Securities and Exchange Commission in (SEC). Bajan could not answer at first, but later said “yes” after getting some signal from the defense, prompting the prosecutor to ask the court to stop her from getting coached. Bajan also hesitated when asked by Divinagracia to confirm if the signature appearing in the original Articles of Partnership of the accounting firm she worked with was hers, and she dithered and said she cannot remember the 2003 documents of Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano & Co., causing uproar among the senators who told her pointblank that it was unacceptable that she could not answer such a simple question. Still, Bajan said the signature was similar as hers but insisted she cannot recall signing the document that contains her tax account number. Sensing that she is not being truthful, Escudero, Sens. Bam Aquino and Francis Pangilinan warned her that she is in “danger zone,” which could lead to a contempt citation or even a case of perjury.


Divinagracia noted that the firm Elises and Ciudadano is the same Elises and Ciudadano which is the external auditor of GenCorp Industries Inc., Metro City Chow Foods, and Great Jolly Times, all of which are businesses in which Sara and her hubby own shares of stock. Pangilinan points out that the address of Bajan’s former accounting firm – Ampil, Elises, Ciudadano & Co. – in Davao City is the same address of the auditing firm of GenCorp and Metro City Chow. Bajan also denied knowing anything about GenCorp, Pikimong Pikimong and other companies …

author: Charlotte Morritt-Jacobs
title: From the battlefield to barriers at home: Remembering Indigenous veterans in Yellowknife
content:
One by one, veterans, cadets, Elders and community leaders line up for a smudge to mark the beginning of Yellowknife’s

Indigenous Veterans Day ceremony

.


For the first time, the annual gathering incorporates traditional practice and offers participants a moment to ground themselves, reflect and honour First Nations, Inuit and Métis people who served in Canada’s military.


Retired chief warrant officer Richard Francoeur says the day provides Indigenous veterans recognition for their service and sacrifices.


“There are so many people from the Indigenous communities that went into wars that a lot of people weren’t aware of,” Francoeur told

APTN News.


He says Indigenous people have served in conflicts throughout Canada’s military history, including the First and Second World Wars, as well as NATO and United Nations operations.


Indigenous Veterans Day is recognized across Canada on Nov. 8.


A Métis veteran lays a wreath at the memorial in Yellowknife’s Lakeview Cemetery paying respects to those who served. Photo: Charlotte Morritt-Jacobs/APTN.


Returning home 


During the Yellowknife ceremony, attendees heard how some Indigenous veterans returned home to a country that did not recognize their service on equal terms.


Many faced racism and prejudice and were denied the same veterans benefits, land grants and reintegration support available to non-Indigenous veterans.


A reflection shared during the ceremony described the difficult choice some veterans faced between their military identities and their Indigenous identities.


“Many were forced to choose between their identities as soldiers or their identities as Indigenous peoples and often experienced barriers from receiving veterans benefits,” Framcoeur said.


Indigenous soldiers also brought skills from their communities onto the frontlines. The ceremony recognized their knowledge of tracking, marksmanship and the land, along with the use of Indigenous language such as Cree, which helped encode military communications during the Second World War.


The ceremony also recognized the 80 veterans buried at Yellowknife’s Lakeview Cemetery, many of them Indigenous.


Organizers paid tribute specifically to two Métis soldiers from the Northwest Territories who died during the First World War.


Private George McKenzie, from Fort Resolution, died on active service on Nov. 9, 1918.


Private Frank McPherson, from Fort Simpson, died three days earlier, on Nov. 6, 1918.


The ceremony included two minutes of silence, an Act of Remembrance and readings by cadets from Yellowknife.


Cadets line up to take part in Yellowknife’s Indigenous Veterans Day ceremony. For the first time, the annual ceremony incorporated the traditional practice of smudge. Photo: Charlotte Morritt-Jacobs/APTN.


Cadets help keep the stories alive


The history was not lost on the younger generation.


Blake Ohokannoak, a cadet with 2837 Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry said he hopes people continue to share the stories.


“I think more Canadians should know about the discrimination they face while serving and after serving,” he said.


Ohokannoak, who is Inuit, has been involved with cadets for four years. He says his interest in the program started with his father, who was a commanding officer with the Cambridge Bay Cadets.


Jason Meyer has been a cadet with the 825 Yellowknife Royal Canadian Elks for a year. His father was a member of the Canadian Rangers in Nunavut.


Meyer said attending the ceremony is personal for him.


“I’m Inuit, so I come every year that I can, so I can honour those who served,” he said.


The cadets also help maintain the Field of Honour and take part in the annual remembrance activities, including placing candles in honour of Indigenous veterans.


The post

From the battlefield to barriers at home: Remembering Indigenous veterans in Yellowknife

 appeared first on

APTN News

.

author: Dennis Ward
title: Australia’s inaugural Ambassador for First Nations People visits Canada
content:
Four years ago, the Australian government took a step that no other country has taken when it created the position of Ambassador for First Nations People.

The ambassador, Justin Mohamed, is a Gooreng Gooreng man from Bundaberg in Queensland.

Mohamed recently visited Canada for a series of high-level meetings with Canadian ministers, including Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull-Masty.

The ambassador also met with national Indigenous organizations and economic groups. Among the similarities between the two countries, says Mohamed, is the effort to involve Indigenous peoples in economic opportunities.

“For the first time, in my 36 years of working in Indigenous affairs, where both of our leaders are talking very positively about the uplift of economic engagement with our First peoples in our country and seeing the benefits of that,” says Mohamed on the latest episode of Face to Face.

“Obviously, here there is things that we can learn and things that Canada can learn from Australia. Our vast country, we’ve got a lot of land mass, we’ve got so many people spread across that, how to get those connections across our land and hopefully across our waters so we have more connections from country to country.”

The ambassador says Australia has strong laws and policies around consultation when it comes to mining and development on Indigenous Peoples’ lands.

However, he acknowledges that can be improved.

“With the new uptake of critical minerals, the renewable energies, that’s definitely a big conversation piece that is taking place and structures and Traditional Owner Groups as we call them in Australia are positioning themselves to be economically part of these new developments and hopefully learn from the past,” says Mohamed.

We have a long relationship with mining companies, with communities, hopefully learning from those experiences and that we can have a better relationship with the critical minerals, renewable energy space. We know this is a conversation and there’s a whole range of things that wrap around that that are taking place as we sit here,” adds Mohamed.

One of the previous roles Justin Mohamed had was chief executive officer of Reconciliation Australia.

The non-government, not-for-profit was established in January 2001 to promote a continuing national focus for reconciliation between Indigenous and non-Indigenous Australians.

While he believes reconciliation has come a long way since he was a child, Mohamed says there are still challenges.

“I think the appetite sways back and forth when you have different governments and political leaders and also things that kind of hit us and impact us and the focus and the direction and the energy may be diverted like pandemics or global crashes in our economy these things happen,” says Mohamed.

“I think one of the things that is staying on course is ensuring there’s a path that we still got to walk and that’s part of our history. So, I think in Australia to be fair and as honest as I can be around where we are, we’ve taken steps, but the journey is still a long way in front of us to keep going on that and there’s still healing our nation needs to have collectively together,” he adds.

Dennis is Métis from southern Manitoba. After spending a decade working in TV in Alberta and Ontario, Dennis returned to Manitoba to join APTN. In 2016, he won a Canadian Association of Journalists award for his story A Soldier Scorned for APTN Investigates. In 2017, he became a host/producer for APTN National News and Face to Face.

author: Administrador
title: PREGUNTAS
content:
A las familias buscadoras sin y con colectivo:

Desde el día 3 de octubre, en horas de la tarde, personas cercanas a la glorieta de los desaparecidos, anunciaron en sus redes sociales que estaba confirmado un encuentro, el 6 de diciembre, de colectivos de familiares y el EZLN en la Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos, mientras la Comisión Sexta mantenía una reunión con enviados de la Sexta Nacional, y a la que asistieron, sin invitación, varias buscadoras.

Días después, alguien y a nombre de las familias buscadoras de “La Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos”, circuló en sus redes una “invitación”. Por varios medios se les hizo saber que no era el conducto. Que mandaran la invitación vía el Frayba, quien nos apoyaba y apoya en todo lo referente a registro y propuestas de familias, grupos y colectivas de buscadoras.

Entonces, después de varios días también, les mandamos mensajes por varios lados. Que retiraran la invitación porque en esos términos iba a ser rechazada. Que contenía menciones que podrían considerarse síntoma de que no conocían a quien invitaban, y cosas que podrían considerarse ofensivas para las comunidades zapatistas.

Además de que no era ese tipo de “reuniones” las que pensaba la Comisión Sexta Zapatista, y que correspondía a la delegación zapatista el definir su agenda con fechas y horas.

No sólo no nos hicieron caso, sino que aumentaron su difusión agregando que era seguro que se daría la reunión con la delegación zapatista en la glorieta, poniendo fecha, y hasta hora en algunos casos.

Insistimos mandándoles mensajes de que rehicieran la invitación por lo mismo. Mientras, seguía creciendo la confusión, y colectivas y grupos empezaban a cambiar sus fechas para estar presentes en “LA” reunión. Les advertimos que nos estaban orillando a un desmentido público. Esto es, a una respuesta severa para aclarar.

Hasta donde entendemos, el espacio de La Glorieta de las y los Desaparecidos no es una organización, sino un espacio de encuentro. Esto es, no tienen una vocería ni dirección establecida. Es un lugar donde suelen converger grupos y colectivas de familias buscadoras. Supusimos que tienen o tenían un mecanismo para hacer acuerdos y tomar decisiones. Y que, por lo tanto, someterían a ese mecanismo la pertinencia o no de esa redacción que, lo sabían con antelación, provocaba molestia en los zapatistas.

La “invitación” contiene 3 elementos fundamentales:

1.- Se ofrece a los zapatistas apoyo. Por eso “invitaron” a las comunidades zapatistas a que llevaran fotos de sus desaparecidos, y que nos iban a enseñar cómo se hace una ficha de desaparición forzada, cómo se pega en la glorieta – junto con cientos de fotos de desaparecidos-, qué trámites hay que hacer para que una ONG otorgue financiamiento, a quién dirigirse en la pirámide gubernamental, etc.

Hermanas familias buscadoras: en territorio zapatista y en las comunidades que fueron zapatistas y ahora son partidistas, NO HAY DESAPARICIONES FORZADAS desde hace 30 años.

Miren, hay grupos feministas que conocen todo lo relacionado con feminicidios. Otros con infanticidios. Otros con trata de personas. Otros con crímenes impunes. Otros en homofobia. Otros en racismo y segregación. Y así con cada uno de los horrores que se padecen en esta geografía llamada México.

Antes de ofrecernos cursos de qué hacer por estos problemas, ¿no es de esperar que al menos investiguen la tasa, ya no digan de feminicidios, sino de violencia de género en general? Porque sí, en territorios zapatistas no hay feminicidios. Ni infanticidios, ni crímenes impunes. Ni trata de personas (comercio, pues, compra venta de hombres, mujeres e infantes). Y así sea usted güero, alto y habla una lengua incomprensible, entra y sale de territorio zapatista sin ser desaparecido, humillado, burlado, esclavizado, asesinado.

Ni homofobia. author: Chris Walker
title: Outgoing GOP Texas Lt. Gov. Wants to Limit His Democratic Successor’s Powers
content:
Texas Republicans could convene a special session, voting to limit Democrats’ executive powers before they are sworn in.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Texas Republican Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick has called for GOP lawmakers in the state legislature to pass new limits on his Democratic successor, Lt. Gov.-elect Vikki Goodwin, who won in the state’s “blue wave” last week.

Patrick issued the call to alter the powers of his own office during an appearance on a conservative radio show on Monday.

The office of lieutenant governor has far more powers in Texas than it does in other states. Amending such powers would impose significant limitations on the incoming Democratic-controlled executive branch.

“I support the Republicans standing up for their voters,” Patrick said in his call to limit Goodwin’s future powers, adding that Republicans should make the changes to “protect the conservative majority.”

Patrick’s remarks disregard that Texas voters overwhelmingly rejected the GOP’s agenda in the midterm elections. Democratic candidate for governor Gina Hinojosa, for example, ousted incumbent Republican Gov. Greg Abbott by more than seven points in last week’s elections. Meanwhile, Goodwin won her race by over six points, and Democrats also won control of the state House of Representatives.

Yet, because Republicans retained control of the state Senate, any changes state lawmakers make to the powers of the office of lieutenant governor during the interim period would be difficult to undo once Democrats assume office. Indeed, Democratic lawmakers would likely have to pursue a lawsuit to challenge any such changes, which would put the matter into the hands of the state’s still conservative judicial system.

Texas Republican lawmakers indicated they were considering changes to the governor’s and lieutenant governor’s powers shortly after Hinojosa’s and Goodwin’s victories.

“We still have total power in Texas, and we must act like it by using the remaining ten weeks to restore separation of powers and limit the emergency powers that Governor-Elect Hinojosa is set to inherit,” read a social media post from state Rep. Brian Harrison (R), who called on Abbott to convene a special session of the legislature to implement the changes.

Hinojosa warned against lawmakers taking such actions.

“The people of Texas have spoken,” she said in response to the proposed plan.

Goodwin similarly argued against Republicans stripping her and the governor-elect of their executive branch powers, stating that they would be doing so “at their peril because we will have elections again in 2028.”

At the same time, movement media is vital in the fight against Trump’s authoritarian reign. Our mandate to tell the truth, share strategies for resistance, and speak against fascism is ever more urgent in this deluge of political censorship and misinformation. Yet, we are struggling to meet our publishing costs when our work is so urgently needed.

We are fundraising right now for those basic operating expenses — we need $50,000 in the next 9 days. If you can support Truthout with a one-time or monthly donation, you will make a significant impact on our work. Anything you can do makes a difference.

author: Sara Gabler
title: Impeachment Won’t Undo Hegseth’s Christian Nationalist Remake of Defense Dept
content:
As calls for his impeachment mount, Hegseth is further entrenching his violent legacy of Christian supremacy and sexism.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Stunning Republican losses in the midterms could spell the end of Pete Hegseth’s tenure as the secretary of defense. From Vice President JD Vance to Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Kentucky), Hegseth’s own party is setting him up to take the fall for election losses blamed on the U.S. war with Iran.

In a rambling post on X on November 4, Vance said the reason the GOP lost was “obvious to almost everyone.” Though he never named Iran or Hegseth, he conceded that Republicans didn’t listen to voters’ demands to “end the war.”

Massie has gone even further. On November 9, he reintroduced articles of impeachment against Hegseth — articles he had already filed this September — citing Hegseth’s violations of the War Powers Resolution, among other charges.

“We’re not indicting him for being bad at his job,” Massie said at a press conference about the impeachment. “In fact, he was very effective at killing schoolchildren in Iran. He was very effective at extrajudicial killings.”

On November 8, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-New York) announced his support of Massie’s proposed resolution, saying “Pete Hegseth has got to go.”

Hegseth is standing his ground. At a press conference this morning, Hegseth lashed out at Massie, calling him “a single rogue legislator loaded with personal animus for the president.“ Hegseth referred to his own track record as “lawful” and “successful.”

And in his video post on November 5, Hegseth had asserted that the war with Iran “is a courageous and historic effort,” adding, “We don’t back down, and that especially applies now.” Amid sycophantic statements about Donald Trump’s leadership, Hegseth also appealed to Congress to continue funding the so-called Department of War and to dismiss people like Massie, whom Hegseth called “obsessed” with him.

Whether or not Hegseth takes the fall for Trump’s new forever war with Iran, the damage has already been done, including the thousands of civilian casualties and the wide-reaching cost of living crisis it exacerbated.

Andrew Whitehead, a sociologist, scholar of religion, and author of the 2024 book, American Idolatry: How Christian Nationalism Betrays the Gospel and Threatens the Church, told Truthout that “the repercussions of declaring this war will still be felt even if it ends tomorrow.”

On February 28, 2026, a U.S. attack on a girls school in Minab, Iran, killed more than 150 civilians, most of them children. That attack wasn’t an anomaly. According to the National Iranian American Council, the U.S. has targeted civilian infrastructure including dozens of airports, hundreds of health centers, and over 1,300 schools.

In addition to overseeing “Operation Epic Fury,” Hegseth was responsible for slashing the Pentagon’s Civilian Protection Center of Excellence, which would have investigated the attacks, by 90 percent.

The war with Iran has also deepened the U.S. energy crisis, and as the winter approaches, the National Energy Assistance Directors Association predicts that utility costs will skyrocket as much as 50 percent. The group’s executive director, Mark Wolfe, writes, “At some point the war in Iran will end, but the affordability crisis will not end with it.”

With or without Hegseth, Trump’s decision to go to war also further diminished the stature of the United States on the global stage. “Those bonds of international trust are not easily rebuilt,” Whitehead said.

That erosion of trust also underlies Massie’s articles of impeachment against Hegseth. In addition to citing the unconstitutionality of the war in Iran, Massie points to a number of international actions taken under Hegseth’s direction: extrajudicial killings in the Caribbean and Pacific; the kidnapping of Nicolás Maduro, a sovereign leader; and the U.S.’s little-discussed “Operation Rough Rider” campaign in Yemen.

Hegseth makes a compelling scapegoat for Republican losses. It’s not hard to see why many Americans would show up to the ballot box to vote out GOP leaders who supported the war in Iran, as multiple polls pointed to the war in Iran as a main issue for voters.

But the Christian Right continues to stand behind Hegseth’s brand of Christian nationalism. Though it is still too early to have precise …

author: Stelinsky
title: Η γαλλική νεολαία στους δρόμους ενάντια σε ένα ζοφερό μέλλον
content:
Το παρακάτω κείμενο προέκυψε κατόπιν μετάφρασης και διαλογής αποσπασμάτων από το “French Youth Take the Streets against a Bleak Future”, 6 Οκτωβρίου 2026, CrimethInc. Διαθέσιμο στο: https://crimethinc.com/2026/10/06/french-youth-fight-against-a-bleak-future.

Την περασμένη εβδομάδα, χιλιάδες έφηβοι κατέβηκαν στους δρόμους της Γαλλίας, συγκρουόμενοι με την αστυνομία, καθώς διαδήλωναν ενάντια στις άθλιες συνθήκες που επικρατούν στα λύκειά τους, αλλά και απέναντι σε ένα μέλλον που μοιάζει να καταρρέει με ταχύτατους ρυθμούς. […] Πρόκειται για ένα ενθαρρυντικό σημάδι, καθώς μετατοπίζει την προσοχή από τη φαινομενικά ασταμάτητη άνοδο της ακροδεξιάς προς το ερώτημα του τι μπορούν να κάνουν οι άνθρωποι από τα κάτω για να υπερασπιστούν τον εαυτό τους. Μέσα σε μια περίοδο κατά την οποία ενισχύεται ολοένα περισσότερο η δημοτικότητα του ακροδεξιού Εθνικού Συναγερμού, έχει ιδιαίτερη σημασία το γεγονός ότι έφηβοι αρχίζουν να οργανώνονται σε επίπεδο βάσης. […] Η οργάνωση αυτή πήρε νέα δυναμική την περασμένη εβδομάδα, όταν αποκλεισμοί λυκείων, διαδηλώσεις και ταραχές ξέσπασαν σε ολόκληρη τη Γαλλία, αιφνιδιάζοντας τους πάντες. Τοιχογραφία που απεικονίζει στιγμιότυπο στο Saint-Ouen-l’Aumone. 14χρονος χτυπήθηκε στο πρόσωπο από αστυνομικό που χρησιμοποιούσε εκτοξευτή χειροβομβιδών, προκαλώντας του διπλό κάταγμα στη γνάθο και σπασμένα δόντια. Όλος ο κόσμος μισεί την αστυνομία. Άδεια για να σκοτώνουν; Από την πρώτη εκλογή του Εμάνουελ Μακρόν στην προεδρία, τον Μάιο του 2017, ο πολιτικός λόγος στη Γαλλία διακατέχεται όλο περισσότερο από αυταρχικές και ακροδεξιές αντιλήψεις, ιδιαίτερα για ζητήματα ασφάλειας, μετανάστευσης, αλλά και οικονομικών και κοινωνικών πολιτικών.[…] Αυτή η μετατόπιση προς μια ακόμη πιο επιθετική μορφή διακυβέρνησης έχει συνοδευτεί από αυξανόμενη κρατική βία απέναντι στα κοινωνικά κινήματα και τις εξεγέρσεις που έχουν ξεσπάσει τα τελευταία χρόνια. […] Μια «βουτιά σε έναν κόσμο επιτήρησης, καταστολής και απώλειας ατομικών ελευθεριών», που έχει πλέον μετατραπεί στη «νέα κανονικότητα». […] Στο ίδιο πλαίσιο εντάσσουν και την προτεινόμενη αλλαγή της νομοθεσίας για τη χρήση πυροβόλων όπλων από την αστυνομία και τη χωροφυλακή. Εφόσον ψηφιστεί, υποστηρίζουν, θα μπορούσε να δημιουργήσει ένα επικίνδυνο προηγούμενο, καθώς θα καθιέρωνε «ένα τεκμήριο “νόμιμης χρήσης όπλων” από αστυνομικούς και χωροφύλακες “κατά την άσκηση των καθηκόντων τους”». Ο νέος νόμος αποτελεί ένα νομοθετικό εργαλείο που επιτρέπει στις δυνάμεις επιβολής του νόμου και, κατ’ επέκταση, στο κράτος, να συγκαλύπτουν μελλοντικές δολοφονίες*. …Αυξανόμενη απογοήτευση Τα αιτήματα των μαθητών αφορούν, μεταξύ άλλων, τη μείωση του αριθμού των μαθητών ανά τάξη, τη μείωση των εβδομαδιαίων διδακτικών ωρών και τη βελτίωση των υποδομών των λυκείων. Ζητούν επίσης το τέλος του Parcoursup, της ηλεκτρονικής πλατφόρμας μέσω της οποίας οι μαθητές δηλώνουν τις επιλογές τους για σπουδές. Η πλατφόρμα έχει δεχθεί κριτική για την αδιαφάνεια των κριτηρίων επιλογής, και για τον ανταγωνισμό και την πίεση που δημιουργεί μεταξύ των μαθητών. Ένα ακόμη αίτημα αφορά την πρόσληψη περισσότερων αναπληρωτών εκπαιδευτικών, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η συνέχεια της διδασκαλίας όταν απουσιάζουν οι μόνιμοι καθηγητές. Όλο και περισσότερο, τα δημόσια σχολεία διοικούνται σαν ιδιωτικές επιχειρήσεις, και αναγκάζονται να ανταγωνίζονται μεταξύ τους για να είναι πιο αποτελεσματικά. Στον καπιταλισμό, το εκπαιδευτικό σύστημα αποτελεί εργαλείο του κράτους για να μας εξαναγκάζει, να συνθλίβει την ατομικότητά μας, να υποτάσσει το επαναστατικό μας πνεύμα και τις επιθυμίες μας, προκειμένου να μας μετατρέψει σε πειθήνιο εργατικό δυναμικό που μπορεί να εκμεταλλεύεται για το υπόλοιπο της ζωής.[…] Παρανάλωμα του Πυρός Μέχρι τη Δευτέρα 28 Σεπτεμβρίου, η είδηση είχε πλέον διαδοθεί μεταξύ των μαθητών και άρχισαν να συντονίζουν δράσεις σε μεγαλύτερη κλίμακα. Οι εικόνες που διαδίδονταν στα μέσα κοινωνικής δικτύωσης πιθανότατα βοήθησαν στη διάδοση της είδησης, δημιουργώντας ένα φαινόμενο ντόμινο μεταξύ των εφήβων: «Κοίτα τι κάνει το άλλο λύκειο. Ας το κάνουμε κι εμείς!» […] Αυτή η πρώτη ημέρα δράσης έθεσε τον τόνο για την υπόλοιπη εβδομάδα, καθώς το κίνημα εξαπλώθηκε πέρα από το Παρίσι και τα προάστιά του. Χωρίς δισταγμό, ο Λοράν Νουνιέζ, ο σημερινός υπουργός Εσωτερικών και πρώην αρχηγός της Αστυνομίας του Παρισιού από το 2022 έως το 2025, αποφάσισε να καταστείλει το αναδυόμενο κίνημα μέσω ωμής βίας. Αστυνομικές δυνάμεις στάλθηκαν στα λύκεια για να διαλύσουν τους αποκλεισμούς και να διασκορπίσουν τα πλήθη των εφήβων. Οι συγκρούσεις …

author: Qassam Muaddi
title: What Will a New Israeli Government Actually Mean for Palestinians?
content:
The Arab vote made it possible to oust Netanyahu for the first time in nearly two decades.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Israel might be coming closer to resolving its political impasse following last month’s elections, as Israeli President Yitzhak Herzog officially tasked Gadi Eisenkot, the main rival of Benjamin Netanyahu, with forming a government.

Netanyahu, who ran with the hopes of staying in power, lost seven of the 54 seats won by the camp under his leadership. On Thursday, the Ashkenazi Haredi ultra-Orthodox party, Yehodot HaTorah, announced that it would no longer support Netanyahu, effectively reducing his camp to 46 seats in the Knesset, Israel’s parliament. Yehodot HaTorah decided not to nominate any candidate for prime minister during the consultations that the Israeli president concluded on Thursday with different parties, before deciding to tap Eisenkot to form a government. The Haredi party’s decision came as a response to Netanyahu not delivering on his promise to the Haredi community to put their exemption from the military draft into law.

On the other hand, Arab-Palestinian parties allied in the Joint List have stated that they will nominate Gadi Eisenkot, thereby contributing to the majority needed to form a government, provided that Eisenkot’s other allies, especially Avigdor Liberman, who refuses to ally with Arab parties, maintain their support.

Netanyahu might be in his final days as head of the Israeli government, after 18 years and six governments in office. He might also be facing an investigation by a commission over the security failure on October 7, and charges in Israeli courts for his ongoing corruption cases. However, although significant for Israeli politics, how much difference would such a change mean for the Palestinian people, and for the region?

The scene could have looked very different, as it did after the 2015 and 2022 elections, with Netanyahu easily achieving a majority and staying in power. The difference, this time, is the massive turnout of Palestinian citizens of Israel, descendants of the minority who weren’t expelled in 1948, who represent around 2 million people today, and a fifth of Israel’s population. Two weeks ago, for the first time in Israel’s history, their 80% turnout gave the two main Arab lists 19 seats in the Knesset, blocking both Netanyahu and Eisenkot from reaching the 61-seat majority required to form a government.

This development didn’t come in a vacuum. In the past three years, the world witnessed an unrestrained display of what has been Israel’s policy towards the Palestinian people since 1948. But what Palestinians witnessed was even more crude. In Gaza, Palestinians lived the genocide in their own flesh. Outside of Gaza, Palestinians were forced to watch what the Israeli war machine did to their own people in Gaza, with threats of unprecedented repression if they spoke out. In other words, they were forced to normalize these new levels of brutality and accept them as the new norm. For Palestinian citizens of Israel, this was particularly consequential. In the years before October 2023, Palestinian mobilization within Israel was on the rise, with citizens protesting home demolitions, the expulsion of Bedouin communities in the Negev, the state’s indifference towards organized crime in Arab communities, the events of Sheik Jarrah and Jerusalem, and also in Gaza. That mobilization was forced into silence.

The past three years also saw a very aggressive and explicit affirmation of the most anti-Arab racist tendencies. This included resolutions voted on in the Knesset, such as the resolution rejecting any Palestinian statehood west of the Jordan River, passed in July 2024, and the rhetoric of politicians and the media calling for the expulsion and extermination of Gaza, or calling for the “transfer” of Arabs in Israel by ministers like Bezalel Smotrich. The Palestinian community needed some kind of response to remind Israel that they are present and part of the country. This is, in part, what their massive turnout in the recent Israeli elections was about.

But it was also more than just making a point or sending a message. After all, the Palestinian vote put its weight behind the immediate project of ousting Netanyahu, which could only come through a government headed by Gadi Eisenkot, which makes it imperative to ask: what …

title: Bakan Bak’tan kredi ve burslara ilişkin açıklama: “Sıkıntı yok, halledeceğiz”
content:
AKP Samsun Milletvekili Mehmet Muş başkanlığında toplanan TBMM Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonu'nda Gençlik ve Spor Bakanlığı ile bağlı kuruluşlarının 2027 yılı bütçesi, 2025 yılı kesin hesabı ve Sayıştay raporlarının görüşmeleri tamamlandı. Gençlik ve Spor Bakanı Osman Aşkın Bak, milletvekillerinin değerlendirmelerinin ardından soruları yanıtladı.

Bak, eski milli sporcuların futbol müsabakalarını ücretsiz izleyebilmesine yönelik talebine ilişkin, mevcut yönetmelikte bu konuda düzenleme bulunduğunu, ancak güncelleme yapacaklarını belirtti. Stadyumların kulüpler tarafından işletilmesi nedeniyle uygulamada bazı sorunlar yaşandığını ifade eden Bak, ilgili kulüplerle görüşerek talebi sisteme yerleştirmeyi planladıklarını söyledi.

KYK yurtlarının kapasitesine ilişkin eleştirilere yanıt veren Bak, yurt kapasitesini 1 milyona çıkardıklarını belirtti. Yurt yatırımlarının sürdüğünü ifade eden Bak, 2026 yılı sonuna kadar yapım ve kiralama yoluyla 29 yurdun tamamlanacağını, bunların toplam kapasitesinin 31 bin olacağını söyledi.

İnşaatı devam eden 21 yurdun 25 bin kişilik kapasite sağlayacağını belirten Bak, ihale aşamasında da yaklaşık 32 yurt bulunduğunu ve bunların tamamlanmasıyla 34 bin kişilik kapasite daha oluşturulacağını kaydetti.

Yurt başvurularının yüzde 96'sının karşılandığını ifade eden Bak, öğrencilerin aylık bin 300 ila bin 450 lira arasında değişen ücretlerle barındığını, sabah kahvaltısı ve akşam yemeğinin ücretsiz verildiğini söyledi. Yurtlardaki denetimlere ilişkin de bilgi veren Bak, mutfaklara kamera yerleştirildiğini, öğrencilerin denetim süreçlerine ve öğrenci temsilcilikleri aracılığıyla yönetime dahil edildiğini belirtti.

Adana Sarıçam'da bin kişilik, Ankara Beştepe'de 2 bin 500 kişilik yurt inşaatlarının sürdüğünü aktaran Bak, Antalya Konyaaltı'nda 2 bin 667 kişilik yurdun yüzde 82 seviyesine ulaştığını, Finike'de de yurt inşaatlarının devam ettiğini söyledi. Tekirdağ'da yeni yurt yatırımı bulunduğunu, Çorlu, Ergene, Malkara ve diğer ilçelerde gençlik merkezlerinin hizmet verdiğini de sözlerine ekledi.

Öğrenci burs ve kredilerine ilişkin değerlendirmelerde de bulunan Bak, 4 bin lira olan burs miktarının 2026-2027 döneminde artırılacağını söyledi. Yaklaşık 650 bin öğrenciye karşılıksız burs verildiğini, 800-850 bin öğrenciye ise kredi sağlandığını belirten Bak, 2022 yılında yaklaşık 22 milyar liralık öğrenci kredi borcunun silindiğini hatırlattı.

Kredi geri ödemelerinin öğrencinin eğitimini tamamlamasının ardından başladığını, mezuniyet sonrasında işe girene kadar iki yıl boyunca ödeme talep edilmediğini ifade eden Bak, tahsilat işlemlerinin Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı tarafından yürütüldüğünü söyledi.

Bak, "Sıkıntı yok. Bütçe yapıyoruz. Merak etmeyin. Bütçe içerisinde kaydırma yaparak halledeceğiz" ifadesini kullandı.

author: Chris Walker
title: Trump Attacks Massie After Lawmaker Files Impeachment Articles Against Hegseth
content:
The president falsely claimed that Hegseth is “the most popular” military official in the country.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

President Donald Trump made a surprise appearance at a White House press briefing on Monday, attacking Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Kentucky) following the lawmaker’s submission of articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

Massie is “a sick, sick guy. There’s something wrong with him, actually,” Trump said during the presser. “Now he’s after Pete Hegseth. He doesn’t like Hegseth, but really, what has Hegseth done?”

“He shouldn’t be taking up the time of Congress, or the Senate or anything that he’s doing. The guy’s a stone-cold loser,” Trump added.

The president told the press that he didn’t watch Massie’s announcement of the impeachment articles. He also didn’t respond to any of the charges the lawmaker is leveling against Hegseth, instead focusing on belittling Massie’s character.

Earlier in the day, Massie filed eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth, which included accusations that the defense secretary engaged in unlawful war or military actions, ignored statutes designed to minimize civilian casualties, and suppressed the free speech rights of members of Congress.

“Secretary Hegseth knowingly executed and implemented unlawful orders to initiate war against a foreign nation,” Massie’s impeachment articles stated, adding that Hegseth “has demonstrated that he will remain a threat to civilians, the lawful conduct of United States military operations, the integrity and credibility of the United States Armed Forces, and the Constitution if allowed to remain in office.”

Trump continued his attacks against Massie on Truth Social on Monday night.

“Defeated Republican Congressman Thomas Massie, a total loser, is trying to Impeach perhaps the most popular and successful military official in the Country, Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth,” Trump wrote.

“Pete Hegseth should be praised, not Impeached,” the president added.

On Tuesday morning, following a press conference in which Hegseth attempted to defend himself against Massie’s impeachment efforts, Trump again attacked Massie.

“Pete Hegseth gets an ‘A’ PLUS, PLUS, PLUS for his defense against a disgruntled, angry, defeated, former Congressman, Thomas Massie, a TOTAL LOSER!” Trump wrote.

Despite Trump’s characterization of Hegseth as “popular,” several polls indicate that the American public is upset with him and wants him out of his position of power.

According to an Economist/YouGov poll conducted in September, 51 percent of Americans support impeaching Hegseth for “starting a war with Iran without authorization from Congress,” while only 34 percent are opposed to the idea. A Quinnipiac University survey from that same month found that only 34 percent of Americans give Hegseth a positive job approval rating, while 57 percent disapprove.

That same poll found that, unlike Trump, most Americans are not confident in Hegseth’s ability to lead the U.S. military, with 56 percent expressing that view and only 39 percent saying they have confidence in him.

title: Giresun’da “temizlik personeli ameliyatlara girdi” iddiasına adli ve idari soruşturma
content:
Giresun İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü, kentte özel bir hastanede temizlik personelinin ameliyatlara girdiği yönünde basına ve sosyal medyaya yansıyan iddialar üzerine adli ve idari soruşturma başlatıldığını bildirdi. Müdürlük, Sağlık Bakanlığının iddiaların araştırılması için müfettiş görevlendirdiğini duyurdu.

Zafer Partisi Giresun İl Başkanı Mesut Aydın, Özel Giresun Ada Hastanesi’nde temizlik görevlisi veya yardımcı personel olarak çalıştığını öne sürdüğü S.T.’nin, tıbbi eğitim ve yetkisi bulunmadan ameliyatlara katılarak hastalara cerrahi müdahalede bulunduğu iddiasıyla Cumhurbaşkanlığı İletişim Merkezine (CİMER) başvurmuştu. Aydın, fotoğraf ve video kayıtlarına dayandırdığı başvurusunda ameliyat kayıtlarının ve geçmiş operasyonların incelenmesini istemişti.

Giresun İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü, iddialara ilişkin yayımladığı açıklamada şu ifadelere yer verdi:

“Bazı basın yayın organları ve sosyal medyada yer alan; Giresun’da özel bir hastanede bir temizlik personelinin ameliyatlara girdiği yönündeki iddialar üzerine, adli ve idari soruşturma başlatılmış olup Bakanlığımızca konuyla ilgili müfettiş görevlendirilmiştir. Kamuoyunun bilgisine saygıyla duyurulur.”

Hastanenin Başhekimi Dr. Cenap Damcı, daha önce yaptığı açıklamada iddiaları reddetmiş, söz konusu kişinin ameliyathanede yardımcı personel olarak görev yaptığını belirtmişti. Hastanede görev yapan Genel Cerrahi Uzmanı Op. Dr. Korhan Arslan da kamuoyuyla paylaşılan görüntülerdeki ameliyatları kendisinin gerçekleştirdiğini açıklamıştı.

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Kuujjuaq festival organizer hopes to spark conversation about Inuit identity
content:
For organizer Saali Kuata, the Path to 100 Festival offers an opportunity to move beyond commemorating the James Bay and Northern Quebec Agreement. It allows for Inuit to examine how it has shaped their communities.


Art can start that conversation.


“Art is just another language that we can use that can transcend language,” said Kuata, Avataq Cultural Institute program director, in an interview.


The Path to 100 festival celebrates the 50th anniversary of the JBNQA and takes place at the Katittavik Theatre in Kuujjuaq from Sunday to Wednesday. It features an art exhibition, performances and workshops, as well as discussions about cultural identity, futurism and economic development.


The governments of Quebec and Canada, as well as representatives for Nunavik Inuit and Crees of Eeyou Istchee, signed the the JBNQA on Nov. 11, 1975. It led to

the creation

 of a school board, a regional government and health-care system in Nunavik.


The festival’s name, Path to 100, reflects a long-term vision for Inuit.


That means Inuit having greater control over the decisions that affect their communities while protecting their cultural identity and rights.


“If we want a sustainable future, we have to put our feet down and determine for ourselves, as we have done before, that nothing goes without us,” he said.


Kuata said he worries that as more Inuit adopt English and participate in the western education system and economy, they risk losing touch with what makes their culture unique.


“We find ourselves attaching our identity and our language to the common culture,” he said.


Besides throat singing, drawing, carving and printmaking workshops, the festival also had performances.


Singer Niivi Snowball, child of musician Etua Snowball, performed on Monday night and dedicated the song

No Pride in Genocide

 to Etua, who was in the audience.


“My writing style is so heavily influenced by him,” Snowball told the audience. “The way he writes music, this heavy-hitting, unapologetically political way of writing his songs influenced me without me even realizing.”


Before performing the song, which addresses suicide and the impacts of colonization, Niivi Snowball urged Inuit to reject the idea that death is their only way out.


“I want you to know that this is not our fault,” Snowball said. “The government, colonization wants us to think that the only way out is to die. But we are strong, and we can fight against it.”

title: Başsavcılıktan Kaşif Kozinoğlu'nun adli tıp raporuna itiraz

Silivri Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, 2011 yılında tutuklu bulunduğu Silivri Cezaevi’nde yaşamını yitiren eski Milli İstihbarat Teşkilatı (MİT) Dış Operasyonlar Daire Başkanı Kaşif Kozinoğlu’nun ölümüne ilişkin Adli Tıp Kurumu 1. İhtisas Kurulu tarafından hazırlanan rapora itiraz etti.

Adli Tıp Kurumunun 3 Kasım 2026 tarihli raporunda, Kozinoğlu’nun kalp hastalığı nedeniyle hayatını kaybettiği, zehirlenme veya travmatik etki sonucu öldüğüne ilişkin tıbbi delil bulunmadığı belirtilmişti.

title: GENAR Başkanı Aktaş: "Yolsuzluğa karışan AKP’li siyasetçi ve idareciler hesap versin"
content:
GENAR Araştırma'nın sahibi İhsan Aktaş, 8 Kasım'da Yeni Şafak'ta yayımlanan "Bu millet AK Parti'den ne istiyor?" başlıklı makalesinde, Türkiye'yi sarsan "fon krizi"ni "AKP yönetiminin içinden kaynaklanan bir sorun" olarak tanımladı. Aktaş, yolsuzluklara karışan iş insanlarının yanı sıra kamu görevlileriyle onları koruyan siyasetçilerin de hesap vermesini istedi.


"AKP 3 puan kaybetti"


Aktaş'ın değerlendirmeleri, GENAR'ın ekim araştırmasında AKP'nin "fon krizi" sonrasında kendi araştırmalarında yaklaşık 3 puan oy kaybettiğinin ortaya çıkmasının ardından geldi.


Aktaş, 18 Ekim'deki ilk yazısında "fon krizinin AK Parti'nin oylarını yüzde 36 bandından yüzde 33,7'ye düşürdüğünü" açıklamış, kaybın sınırlı kalmasını ise "muhalefetin dağınıklığı"na bağlamıştı.


Ancak üç hafta sonra meseleye yalnızca seçim sonuçları açısından yaklaşmadı. 8 Kasım tarihli

yazısında

 krizin kaynağını doğrudan iktidarın yönetim mekanizmasında aradı.


"Dış güçler değil, iktidarın içindeki ilişkiler"


Aktaş, yazısının büyük bölümünü AKP'nin tarihsel misyonunu ve Erdoğan'ın uluslararası önemini savunmaya ayırdıktan sonra sözü "fon krizi"ne getirdi. 


Krizin kaynağının yabancı güçler, darbeciler veya eski vesayet kurumları olmadığını vurgulayan Aktaş, iş insanları, imza yetkisi bulunan kamu görevlileri ve onları koruyan siyasetçiler üzerinden ortaya çıkan tabloyu şöyle tanımladı:


"Doğrudan AK Parti yönetiminin iç travmasıdır."


Bu ifade, başta Erdoğan olmak üzere AKP yetkililerinin sorunu "dış güçler"e bağladıkları bir saldırıyla açıklama teşebbüslerini benimsemeyişiyle dikkat çekiyor.


Aktaş, krize karışan herkesin hukuken hesap vermesini, denetim ve yönetim mekanizmalarının yeniden düzenlenmesini, AK Parti'nin kuruluş dönemindeki reformcu siyasi kimliğinin güçlendirilmesini istedi:


Bu işe bulaşan dolandırıcı, amir, memur, siyasetçi kim varsa hukuk karşısında hesabını vermeli ve milletin sisteme olan güveni yenilenmelidir.


Ancak sorumluluğu Erdoğan'ın liderliğinden ayrı tuttu. Sistem eleştirilerinin Cumhurbaşkanı'na yöneltilmiş eleştiriler gibi gösterilmesine karşı çıkarak liderlik ile yönetim mekanizması arasında kesin bir ayrım yaptı:


"Lider bir misyondur, bir ruhtur."


Buna karşılık sistemi, aksayan parçaları değiştirilmesi gereken teknik bir aygıt olarak tanımladı.


Üç haftada üç yazı: Anketten sistem eleştirisine


Aktaş'ın 8 Kasım'daki değerlendirmesi, 18 Ekim'de GENAR'ın sonuçlarını açıklamasıyla başlayan tartışmanın üçüncü halkası.


18 Ekim'de yayımladığı "AK Parti seçmeni olana razı olmadı fakat partisini terk etmedi" başlıklı yazısında, AKP'nin oy kaybını kabul etmiş ancak seçmenin bütünüyle partiden kopmadığı görüşünü savunmuştu.
